title: Shadowing Without Bounded Distortion
statement: For dissipative composition operators without bounded distortion, is generalized hyperbolicity equivalent to the shadowing property?
background:

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-22)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The equivalence and full shadowing characterization are proved for dissipative composition systems with bounded distortion, but the no-bounded-distortion case remains unresolved.

**Sources checked.**

- [D'Aniello, Darji and Maiuriello](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jde.2021.06.038)
